name: Plate and Shell Heat Exchanger
full_description: The official product page describes this model as an advanced high-efficiency and energy-saving heat exchanger that uses corrugated plates as heat transfer elements, consisting of an internal welded plate bundle and an external shell. It is presented for catalytic reforming, xylene isomerization, toluene disproportionation, propane and propylene condensation, amine solution heat exchange, and other liquid-liquid, vapor-liquid, gas-liquid, and gas-gas processes in oil refining, petrochemical, and gas processing industries.
advantage: Combines the compactness and efficiency of plate heat exchangers with shell-side pressure and temperature resistance.
Gasket-free welded structure is presented for high-temperature and high-pressure duty.
Official page highlights lower weight and smaller size than shell-and-tube alternatives.

seo_data.meta_description: Compact high-efficiency shell-and-plate exchanger for refinery, petrochemical, and gas processing service.
